body.text: Teknoppy is a software development company in Kochi that builds custom business software - internal tools, workflow and reporting systems, software products and upgrades of old desktop or legacy systems. We plan the architecture first, build in stages, and hand over full documentation. Most projects take 8-20 weeks.

As an experienced software development agency in Kochi, we understand that forcing unique operational processes into rigid off-the-shelf software creates costly workarounds and duplicate data entry. We engineer bespoke software systems tailored to your established business workflows.

items.title: Custom & Enterprise Software
items.html: Bespoke business platforms designed specifically around your operational logic, approval chains, and data models, eliminating third-party subscription license creep.

items.title: Business Software Solutions
items.html: Specialized operational systems: ERP, CRM, HRM, and inventory management software engineered around your actual team routines.

items.title: Desktop & Legacy Modernization
items.html: Modernizing legacy Windows desktop applications (Visual Basic, FoxPro, MS Access, older .NET) into secure, responsive cloud web applications with seamless data migration.

items.title: Consulting & Product Development
items.html: Technical architecture consulting, feasibility studies, and building commercial software products to license or sell. For multi-tenant products, see SaaS Development.

items.title: Enterprise Technology Stack
items.text: We build with battle-tested enterprise technologies: .NET Core, Java/Spring, Python (Django/FastAPI), Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server deployed on AWS or Azure.

items.title: Agile Sprint Delivery with Working Demos
items.text: Two-week development sprints with live demonstrations at every milestone, giving your leadership complete visibility into feature progress before final release.

items.title: 100% Source Code & Database Ownership
items.text: Full ownership of source repositories, database models, technical architecture diagrams, and deployment scripts transferred to your organization upon project completion.

items.title: Rigorous QA & Security Compliance
items.text: Automated unit tests, integration testing against real corporate data, vulnerability scanning, and strict role-based access control (RBAC).

items.title: 1. Requirements & Technical Consulting (Weeks 1-2)
items.text: We audit your business processes, interview key department users, and draft a comprehensive Software Requirements Specification (SRS).

items.title: 2. System Architecture & Database Design (Weeks 3-4)
items.text: Entity-relationship modeling, API contracts, security protocols, and selecting cloud infrastructure tailored to your scale.

items.title: 3. Bespoke Sprint-Based Development (Weeks 5-14)
items.text: Iterative module coding with continuous integration, automated test suites, and bi-weekly milestone reviews with your stakeholders.

items.title: 4. Integration & Legacy Data Migration (Weeks 15-17)
items.text: Sanitizing and migrating legacy databases, configuring third-party accounting/ERP integrations, and conducting user acceptance testing (UAT).

items.title: 5. Production Deployment & Team Training (Weeks 18-20)
items.text: Scheduled zero-downtime cutover, hands-on user training workshops, and comprehensive administrative documentation handover.

sections.h2: Custom Software Development Cost in Kochi

paragraphs.text: Custom software pricing is scoped around business module count, user roles, legacy data migration, and third-party integrations:

paragraphs.html: Technical Consulting & Architecture Audit: ₹25,000 – ₹60,000 (Delivery in 1–2 weeks). Comprehensive business process mapping, technical feasibility review, and SRS architecture roadmap.
Departmental Business Software / Internal Tool: ₹85,000 – ₹1,80,000 (Delivery in 8–12 weeks). Bespoke tool automating single-department workflows, reporting, and team access control.
Enterprise Multi-Module Software System: ₹2,00,000 – ₹5,50,000+ (Delivery in 12–20+ weeks). Multi-department ERP/operations platform with complex database models, role hierarchy, and accounting sync.
Legacy Desktop Modernization: ₹1,50,000 – ₹4,00,000 (Phased delivery). Database sanitation, cloud refactoring, and zero-downtime cutover from legacy desktop systems.
Ongoing Maintenance & DevOps Support: ₹15,000 – ₹40,000 / month. Proactive server monitoring, automated daily backups, security patches, and SLA support.

items.q: How is custom software development different from web application development?
items.a: Custom software development covers a broader technical scope — enterprise systems, desktop modernization, internal workflow tools, and on-premise architectures — whereas web application development focuses specifically on browser-based cloud platforms. See our Web Application Development Company Kochi page.

items.q: How much does custom software development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Custom software projects typically range from ₹85,000 to ₹1,80,000 for focused departmental tools (8–12 weeks), and ₹2,00,000 to ₹5,50,000+ for enterprise multi-module platforms (12–20+ weeks). Legacy desktop modernizations typically cost between ₹1,50,000 and ₹4,00,000.

items.q: Should we buy off-the-shelf software or build custom software?
items.a: Buy off-the-shelf when standard SaaS covers at least 80% of your business requirements without major workarounds. Build custom software when your operations are unique, third-party user seat fees are escalating, or proprietary workflows give you a distinct competitive advantage.

items.q: Will we own the software source code and data?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Upon final project completion, all source code, database architectures, documentation, and cloud infrastructure access are transferred entirely to your company with zero ongoing developer license fees.

items.q: How do you migrate data from our existing legacy system?
items.a: We audit your legacy database, sanitize records, create schema transformation scripts, and run parallel staging test runs. We schedule the final cutover during off-peak hours to guarantee zero operational downtime.

items.q: Do you build software as a product, or only internal business tools?
items.a: We build both. For founders and businesses commercializing software products with recurring subscription models, explore our specialized SaaS Development Company in Kochi services.
